chapter.title: Act V: Second Spring
subtitle: Second Spring, Year Two
Re-found the town: finish the square, balance the books, and sink the quarry that pays for the next hundred years.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

hover: The fortieth post, bare since she left.
Nella's first tomato, snow still on the ridge.
One of thirty things for thirty tiles.
Three fish looking down at the long table.
Mill to lake, no wire between them.
Type the box. A side of 64.
Marnie's plate. Seven more to cook.
Pip has already named it Big Copper.
The quarry's own copper, come back up as a bell.

quests.title: Sleep, Then Walk the Square With Marnie
quests.subtitle: Year two, and the noticeboard is longer.
description: Marnie: "Snow's still on the ridge and the square's still standing. Come on, I want you to see it in daylight."
Sleep one night in your own bed, then walk the square with Marnie. She hands you a packet on the way.
Year two opens on thirty bare tiles and Nella's cold frame. What grows when is in the &6Farm & Seasons&r chapter.

tasks.title: A night slept and the square walked with Marnie

rewards.command: /valley scene q76
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Marnie: ","color":"light_purple"},{"text":"The noticeboard's rewritten. Year two, and it's a longer list than last spring.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Year Two, Longer List
rewards.description: Next: glaze Nella's cold frame with 16 Vibrant Quartz Glass, then dress the square's thirty tiles.

quests.title: Glaze the Cold Frame and Grow Four Crops
quests.subtitle: Four crops with snow still on the ridge.
description: Nella: "Glass, and I'll have a tomato up before the snow's off the ridge. I'm not making a speech about it."
Glaze the cold frame with 16 &aVibrant Quartz Glass&r, then grow a tomato, a strawberry, a bell pepper and a corn under it.
2 glowstone dust, 2 quartz glass and 1 cyanite ingot make two panes: eight crafts. The glass lights itself, so nothing under that frame needs a lantern.

tasks.title: Cold frame glazed with 16 Vibrant Quartz Glass

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Nella: ","color":"aqua"},{"text":"I'll take the gardener's job. Don't tell Pip, he'll shout.","color":"white","italic":true}]
/valley standing q77 {team}

rewards.title: The Gardener's Job
rewards.description: Next: three named fish off the pier for the inn wall.

quests.title: Dress the Square's 30 Copper Tiles
quests.subtitle: The square stops looking like a building site.
description: Oda: "Thirty tiles, thirty things. I have a preferred order. Ignore me."
Put one thing on each of the &a30 marked copper tiles&r: 8 flower boxes, 8 candle holders, 6 lanterns, 4 oak benches, 4 planters. Any order is right.
All of it came out of Marnie's packet. Oda's whole catalogue goes free at her counter and the square is finished.

tasks.title: Something on each of the 30 marked copper tiles

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Catalogue's free to you from today. I'll still have opinions.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The Square Is Finished
rewards.description: Next: cook the eight dinners. After that the bell post is the only bare thing left.

quests.title: Catch Three Named Fish for the Inn Wall
quests.subtitle: Bluegill and perch by day, catfish after dark.
description: Nella: "Bluegill and perch off the pier any time. Catfish is a night fish and he wants a worm on the hook."
Catch a bluegill and a perch off the pier in daylight, then a &acatfish&r after dark on a worm. Hang three fish mounts on the inn wall.
Fifty Scrip toward the winter debt. Rods, bait and the rest of the lake are in the &6Animals & Fishing&r chapter.

tasks.title: Three Oak Fish Mounts hung on the inn wall

rewards.title: Three On The Wall
rewards.description: Next: 120 Scrip across Oda's counter clears the winter debt.

quests.title: Build the Second Turbine
quests.subtitle: Same reactor. Same fuel. Twice the power.
description: Tobin: "Second turbine, same reactor, and the fuel line does not move. I did the arithmetic four times, then once more with Bram watching."
Build a second turbine off the reactor you already have, then stand at the terminal, press &bT&r and type &b/valley check power&r.
It ticks at 25,000 or more on 60 or less fuel. Turbines start to finish: the &6Reactor & the Quarry&r chapter.

tasks.title: Both turbines at 25,000+ on 60 or less fuel

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Twenty-five thousand, and the fuel line never moved. That's the town through next winter twice over.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Power For A Quarry
rewards.description: Next: two 16k Crafting Storage and wireless across the whole town.

quests.title: Build the Network Out Across the Town
quests.subtitle: 2 Access Points, 4 Boosters, mill to lake.
description: Bram: "Wireless. In my mill. Fine."
Hold 2 &a16k Crafting Storage&r, 2 ME Wireless Access Points and 4 Wireless Boosters, and seat the boosters in the points.
Every player carries a terminal from anywhere in town. The rest of the network is the &6Storage Network&r chapter.

rewards.title: Wireless, Mill To Lake
rewards.description: Next: pattern the subnet that keeps Marnie's pantry full, then cook the eight dinners.

quests.title: Encode 8 Patterns and Wire Marnie's Pantry
quests.subtitle: The subnet that restocks the inn.
description: Bram: "A box that knows what's in every other box is a list. A box that refills them is a works."
Encode 8 crafting patterns, then hold 2 &aPattern Providers&r and 2 Level Emitters and wire them to the pantry chest: emitter low, provider pushes.
Marnie stops counting bread, and the Delivery Crate fills itself for the eight dinners.

tasks.title: 8 patterns encoded and the pantry subnet running

quests.title: Cut the Rig Pad and Run the Power Lane
quests.subtitle: Legal to build. Not yet legal to run.
description: Tobin: "The pad is mine to cut. The rig is not mine to switch on until the town says so. Different problems."

Level the 9x9 pad on the site the deep survey picked and run &aEnergy Duct&r from the reactor grid out to it. Set the &aFlexible Marker&r on the corner stake and type a box; a side of 64 sits well inside this pack's 256 cap.
Pad cut, lane live. That is the whole rig but the Deed.

tasks.title: Pad levelled on the surveyed site
Energy Duct run from the reactor grid to the pad

rewards.title: The Pad Is Cut
rewards.description: Next: set the rig flat against the marker and switch it on.

quests.title: Cook Each Resident's Favourite Dish
quests.subtitle: Eight plates, eight people.
description: Marnie: "Eight plates, eight people. The crate by the counter already has every ingredient in it. Your network saw to that."

Cook one each: roast chicken for Marnie, beef stew for Bram, cabbage rolls for Oda, fish stew for Nella, mushroom rice for Halden, bacon and eggs for Tobin, fruit salad for Wisp, sweet berry cheesecake for Pip.
You keep the &aFeast Crate&r, one of each, set aside for Founder's Day. Kit and recipes: the &6Cooking & Brewing&r chapter.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"You cooked for eight people who all showed up. Josie managed that twice.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Feast Crate Stored
rewards.description: Next: the boat. Your new compass is already set to the Cairn Chapel and the Drowned Lighthouse.

quests.title: Sail to the Cairn and the Drowned Lighthouse
quests.subtitle: Out past the ridge.
description: Pip: "The chapel's called the Cairn and the lighthouse is called Drowned and I named the boat Biscuit!"
Take the boat out with Nella and Pip and follow the compass to both. A waystone stands at each and the chest is under the beacon beam. Bring back the &aCross Necklace&r and the &aSnorkel&r.
You keep the Warding Lamp. More places worth a boat: the &6Places&r chapter.

rewards.command: title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "And the Drowned Lighthouse past it.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "The Cairn Chapel", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Two Names On The Map
rewards.description: Next: Tobin's lantern line, down under the Works.

quests.title: Bring Back One Echo Shard
quests.subtitle: Down Tobin's lantern line, under the Works.
description: Tobin: "Dead sculk, no Warden. I checked twice, then again with a stick. Mind the third lantern, it hangs crooked."
Follow Tobin's lantern line down into the echo cave under the Works and bring back one &aEcho Shard&r. The Warding Lamp holds the dark off the whole chamber.
Tobin reads the echo off the shard and puts a stake in the ground where the quarry goes.

tasks.title: Reached the echo cave under the Works

rewards.command: title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "Further down than anyone ever dug.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "Deeper and Darker", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: The Quarry Has A Site
rewards.description: Next: cut the rig pad on the site this survey picked, then buy the Works Deed.

quests.title: Pay 120 Valley Scrip at Oda's Counter
quests.subtitle: Eleven years of red ink, cleared.
description: Oda: "Eleven years, and here. You hold the ledger. I have held it long enough."
Hand &a120 Valley Scrip&r across Oda's counter and clear the town's winter debt.
The books balance for the first time since Josie, and 25 Scrip comes straight back across the counter.

rewards.command: /valley standing q85 {team}

rewards.title: The Books Balance
rewards.description: Next: 80 Scrip and Standing: Trusted buys the Works Deed.

quests.title: Standing: Trusted
quests.subtitle: Six of eight neighbours' stories closed.
description: Oda: "I do not keep a book of who likes you. I keep a book of who you have finished a thing for. Six is the number."
Nothing to do here. It ticks itself when the sixth neighbour's chain closes. Press &bT&r and type &b/valley check standing&r for her count.
At six, Oda counts you a local and puts the Works Deed on her counter at 80 Scrip. She will not be talked into rounding up.

tasks.title: Six of eight neighbours' stories closed

rewards.title: Standing: Trusted
rewards.description: Next: 80 Scrip at Oda's counter buys the Works Deed.

quests.title: Buy the Works Deed at Oda's Counter
quests.subtitle: 80 Scrip, and six of eight stories closed.
description: Halden: "Josie meant the Works to belong to whoever stayed. Nobody has argued about it in four years."
Pay &a80 Valley Scrip&r at Oda's counter. The other half of the price is Standing: Trusted, six of the eight resident chains closed, and it opens itself the moment the sixth one does.
The Deed is yours: QuarryPlus becomes craftable, the residents vote, and Bram signs as witness.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a {"text":"The residents vote. Bram signs as witness: 'Kettle Works. Town-held. Good.'","color":"gold"}
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"Eight names on this deed and not one of them hers. She would have been unbearable about it.","italic":true}]
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"If every one of us walked out tomorrow, the lights here would still be on come Thursday. Never been true before.","italic":true}]
/playsound minecraft:block.note_block.bell master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: The Works Deed
rewards.description: Next: set the quarry on Tobin's marker and switch it on.

quests.title: Set the Quarry on the Marker and Switch It On
quests.subtitle: Flat against the marker, facing in.
description: Tobin: "Pad is cut, marker is typed, lane is live. I am extremely calm about this."
Set the &aQuarry&r flat against the Flexible Marker you typed, facing in, and switch it on off the lane you already ran. It builds its own frame.
The shaft sinks. It is the biggest thing Tobin has ever been responsible for and he checks the gauge four times.

tasks.title: Quarry running off the reactor lane

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Right. That's a town works, and I'm going to go and sit down.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The Shaft Sinks
rewards.description: Next: 1,024 cobblestone out of network stock into the granary.

quests.title: Deliver 1,024 Cobblestone to the Granary
quests.subtitle: The first load.
description: Bram: "Rock into the box, box into the granary. That is a public works, not a hole in a hill."
Pattern the quarry's output, cobble to the granary and ore to the pulverizer, then land one full cycle: &a1,024 cobblestone&r out of network stock. The quarry keeps running afterwards.
Oda's shelves restock themselves off your network from now on, and she will check that they did.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"My shelves filled themselves overnight. I have written it in the ledger and I am watching it.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Shelves Fill Themselves
rewards.description: Next: cast a bell from the quarry's own copper.

quests.title: Hang the Copper Bell on the Marked Post
quests.subtitle: Pip has already named it Big Copper.
description: Pip: "I get to ring it, and I already named it! It's called Big Copper!"
Cast one &aBell&r from the quarry's own copper, a copper block ringed by four copper ingots, and hang it on the marked post in the finished square.
Every resident comes out for it. Pip has been the courier since December; from today he has the bell rope.

tasks.title: Bell hung on the marked post in the square

rewards.command: /playsound minecraft:block.bell.use master @a ~ ~ ~ 2 1
/tellraw @a {"text":"Pip rings it eleven times. Nobody stops him.","color":"gold","italic":true}
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Eleven days she ran it, eleven years I kept an empty book, eleven feet of porch — I have stopped calling it chance.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The Bell Is Up
rewards.description: Next: the fortieth lamp, on the bare post at Josie's porch.

quests.title: Put the Fortieth Lamp on Josie's Bare Post
quests.subtitle: The last lamp.
description: Josie, on the last page: "There's a lamp post on my porch with nothing on it. I'd like to be on the line."
Walk up to Josie's porch and put one &aLantern&r on the bare post, the only one on the whole road that never got lit. There are twenty-four in your bag from the road work.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

tasks.title: Fortieth lamp placed on the bare post at Josie's porch

rewards.command: /bossbar set valley:lamps value 40
/tellraw @a {"text":"Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.","color":"gold","italic":true}
/tellraw @p {"text":"Journal Entry 5 has been added to Josie's Journal — the last thing she wrote.","color":"gray"}
title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "The fortieth post, bare since she left.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "Josie's Porch", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Lamps 40/40
rewards.description: Next: set the eight dishes on the long table and bank the Hearth for the night.

quests.title: Set the Eight Dishes and Bank the Hearth
quests.subtitle: Act V finale - Founder's Day.
description: Marnie: "Bring the crate. Everyone is already here. I have never once had to set this many chairs."
Take the eight dishes out of the &aFeast Crate&r, set them on the long table in the inn, and bank the Hearth the way Josie's last page describes: the trick a stranger taught her in the rain.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves. Sit down; you live here.

rewards.command: /valley finale act5

rewards.title: Founder's Day
rewards.description: Next: nothing is next. The story ends here; the valley does not. Go and meet the next stranger.
